sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, time to move on to the most important part, the medicine. And stimulants. You've definitely used them already, otherwise you would not have survived this long in the Arena. Now I need to see how well you learned the lesson. Use stimulants to kill! And fine, if you patch yourself up and then take someone out, I will count that too."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 5 enemies while under the effect of any stimulant or painkiller

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,500 EXP
- 48,000 Roubles
- 10 GP coins
- Unlocks AFAK tactical individual first aid kit in the Armory
